This article is a stub. Taroda Industries was a Chicago maker of electronic athletic timing
equipment that sold the [Kyroscope](../equipment/swimming/timers/kyroscope.md) meet timer from 1969
and the [Kyroscope pace clock](../equipment/common/pace-clock/kyroscope-pace-clock.md) from 1974,
and advertised until 1982.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
